svg.title: Тибиалис-подъём в тренажёре — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Seated tibialis raise machine. Show an identifiable low pivoting lever with a PAD ON TOP OF both forefeet, hinge visible on machine base, and a separate static heel block supporting heels. Side oblique view with both shoes clear, feet together. START ankles neutral with forefeet lower, FINISH toes pull UP toward shins rotating the padded lever upward, while heels stay on same unmoving support. Athlete remains seated. No calf raise and no pad beneath toes. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
